description: Audit one local PDF for accessibility structure, headings, tables, figures, forms, reading order, fonts, scans, metadata and navigation. Returns a compact summary by default, or Markdown, JSON or a self-contained HTML report. No upload and no model call. Scores are triage signals, not a conformance certificate.

maxFindings.description: Maximum findings to return; scores and counts always use every finding (default 500)

minSeverity.description: Only return findings at or above this severity (scores are unaffected)

offset.description: Skip this many findings before returning them (pagination; scores are unaffected)

output.description: Write the report to this path (HTML uses <name>-a11y-report.html in the current directory when omitted)

overwrite.description: Allow replacing an existing output file (default false)

path.description: Path to a local PDF file (absolute, or relative to the server working directory)

name: audit_pdf
title: Audit a PDF
